A prequel story with new characters!

You play as Unice, the apprentice of January.
With the Cabal seemingly winning the war against the factions, you, January, and June come up with a plan to stop it.

This story will be slightly darker and more serious of tone from the main story.
This part of the experimental update will add around 1 hour of extra gameplay.

notes.title: Regarding the v1.2 update
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

It's been a while since I announced the v1.2 update, which was a huge free DLC update to the game that I had planned.
It is unfortunate, but I have come to the decision to cancel this free DLC update.
Let's go over what happened.

Rough Start

When The Lustful Champion was first created, it went through writer's hell.
The original story was rewritten a couple of times, and it was created with help from a few different people.
It was a long road to create the game in the first place, as it was everyone's first time working on a game, and especially the Calories Game was a chore to create.
Eventually, the game was finished and released on Steam.

Going Solo

After the release of The Lustful Champion, there were no plans for DLC or added content, the focus was on bug fixing, and there were a lot of bugs!
After that, I wanted to deliver more content to the game out of love for the game itself.
However, when you go from having a small team of people to going solo, you realize that it's a lot more work than you thought.
After writing the DLC story, which was a prequel to the main story, I worked on the art, story, music, sound effects, animation, and more (for the most part) on my own.
I listened to feedback and created a more choice driven story, which would lead to several different outcomes.

Obviously, looking back, I should've known that I made promises too early on and should've first created the content and then announced it once it was nearly finished.
I bit off more than I could chew.

Writer hell

The prequel story has been rewritten a few times—seven, to be exact.
I wanted to give the players the option to choose different routes they could take.
Some lead to pure adult content, others to adult oriented comedy, and another route would be a more serious and grounded story.
Especially after hearing some complaints from American players that the main story was "offensive", I wanted to make sure the prequel story wasn't offensive.
My aim with this game was for people to have fun, not feel attacked.
It was a satirical game, but I have learned a great deal.

Decision to Cancel

The decision to cancel the planned DLC isn't one that I take lightly, I have tried many different ways to try and save this content, but you can only do so much.
Even though the main game was never intended to have free added content, I really just wanted to give something extra to the people who decided to give the game a chance.
I wanted to give the players more than I could give them.

I have learned from this mistake and will make sure it won't happen again in future projects.
My sincere apologies to the players who were waiting for this content, and my apologies to those who wishlisted the game while waiting for the content update.

What happens next

A lot of work went into the updated content, and to throw it away would be a slap in the face.
Therefore, I want to add the animations to the game in a special "Extra" section.
So players can see the hard work that went into creating them.

Again, my apologies to the players and to the people who were involved in helping with the creation of The Lustful Champion.

notes.title: Update V1.1.5
notes.notes:
V1.1.5

Changed: Title Screen rotates between different backgrounds now.
Changed: CG Gallery and Calories game are now selectable on the Title screen once unlocked under the EXTRA’s menu button
Changed: New Game selection now shows Main Story and the upcoming Free storyline “The Call for a Savior”
Changed: Settings menu changed, “Return to title screen” bug is now fixed. Settings menu will now rotate between “lore art” pages whenever the menu is opened.
Changed: Main Story the first chapter has some changes, making it clear that “California/Amsterdam” that is talked about at the start, is a hyper satirized version in both Dutch and English version.
Changed: To reduce loading time between scenes, most of the loading should be done once the game is launched. Slightly longer load time when starting the game, shorter loading time between scenes.
Prepared: Framework tested but not visible to players that make animated scenes possible for future content.
Added: Title screen now shows the chosen language in the top right corner. Clicking on the flag brings you to the language choice menu.
Added: “Skip read” tutorial and “Auto text” tutorials added to the EXTRA menu so people can rewatch them if needed.
Fixed: “Genital Jumpscare” bug fixed. Playing in censored mode, would sometimes show the genital CG of “Aloe” for no reason. Fixed and squashed


This update is approx 1GB in size due to pre-loading of some systems and assets for the 1.2.0 update that will bring in a whole new story, and extra content.
The reason I chose to do this, is because of the fact that Version 1.2 will be a pretty big free content update, and this way the players don’t have to download a huge chunk in one go.

The Title screen has now been changed, the original title screen could flicker, which could be an issue for those that are sensitive to flickering lights.
The Title screen menu has also been altered to make the CG Gallery and Calories Game easier to access once you’ve unlocked them.
The Title screen now also shows the flag of the language you’ve chosen in the top right corner. You can click on it to return to the language selection menu.

Once you click on “New Game”, you will now see two options (only one is available at this time).
“The Call for a Savior” and “Main Story”.

Issues within the settings menu have also been resolved, the settings menu has been adjusted a bit as well.

Animated test scenes have been loaded into the game, but can not be accessed by players.
The reason they have been put in, is simply to test out if animated scenes can work without issue which are planned for the 1.2.0 content update.

You can now re-check the tutorials on how the “Skip Read” and “Auto Text” buttons work by clicking on the EXTRA button.

Fixed the issue where some players who play the game in “censored” mode, could get an accidental “genital jumpscare”. The bug here is that the uncensored image of Aloe’s genitals could randomly pop up on screen for no reason for players in the “censored mode”.
While it sounds funny, I can understand that players who play the “censored” mode, play so for a reason.
This issue however is extremely rare and would only happen to players with a bugged save file from v1.0.
All players from v1.1 and onward would be safe from this bug. (This only affected BETA testers)

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 - Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867286/7b98f719bfb84262d589e2b0aba3475cd590eeff.png

Hello everyone!
With the launch and fixing of all the bugs that were found, work has been resumed on V1.2.0 of The Lustful Champion.
I want to thank everyone who let me know about some of the bugs that I missed, and also thank you for the suggestions like adding the skip and auto buttons!

Now that work is resumed on v1.2.0 what can you expect?

V1.2.0 of The Lustful Champion will add a new storyline that takes places weeks before the main story, new characters to interact with and more CG Gallery items to unlock!

I want to also say that the content that is being added is all done by one person.
With the creation of the game, there were several people that helped out here and there, but now it's all a one-man-show, so to say.

The reason I say this, is because I don't have a precise date for when I expect v1.2.0 to be finished.
So the only answer I can give is that it's finished when it's finished.
I'll try to update more and more the closer it gets to completion, so I do hope everyone can understand that the update may take a small while.

Thank you for giving the game a chance, and I hope that you will enjoy v1.2.0 once it's finished!

notes.title: Release this month + FREE CONTENT UPDATE
notes.notes:
Dear readers (and hopefully future players),

The release of The Lustful Champion is coming up this month!
So far we haven't found reasons for delaying yet, and are working hard to find any bugs and squash them!
What we did notice in the process was that we forgot to include one of the most basic things in a game...
A loading screen!
Thanks to BETA testers and testing the game on lower-end hardware, we discovered that when the game loads, it would just show a black screen and could confuse players as to why the screen stayed black for a few moments.

EXTRA CONTENT

We are also already working on extra story-related content that shows things from a somewhat different perspective and once that is finished, we will add it as a FREE content update.

While there are always plans to add more content, it is important to wait until we see reviews come in from players so we can fix issues we might have missed and also listen to feedback to make the game better.

It is all very exciting and we hope that those who decide to play the game will enjoy it.

Much love,
-JjustGames & Wetcat Games
